title: StemDeck, a free, open-source and local AI stem separator
summary: StemDeck is a free, open-source, and local AI-powered audio stem separator that allows users to extract individual instrument tracks (vocals, drums, bass, etc.) from audio files without internet connectivity or subscription fees.
problem_solved: Eliminates the need for expensive cloud-based stem separation services by providing a free, private, and offline audio stem extraction tool.
why_valuable: It democratizes audio production by offering free, local stem separation that preserves user privacy and eliminates recurring subscription costs.
